Messages.Author: John M. Baker
Messages.Body:
What happens to the vampire and Bauble card if the Bauble equipment is
stolen or destroyed?

--
"After I zoqo, I like to ushnuu."

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
John M. Baker wrote:
>
> What happens to the vampire and Bauble card if the Bauble equipment is
> stolen or destroyed?

By card text:
Nothing. The Bauble remains, and the vampire with it is still restricted.
You may still burn the Bauble (and the chosen equipment, if it was stolen)
during your untap phase (or at any time, superior).
